author: James Edward Ball
source: Private reproduction repository frozen original eight-category language references

source_text.author: James Edward Ball

classes.definition: Open water with little vegetation or built development.
phrases: Water covers the surface.
The surface is covered by open water.
An area of open water.

classes.definition: Dense, tall vegetation, including wooded cover, dense shrubs and tree plantations.
phrases: Dense tree or tall shrub cover.
A dense canopy of tall vegetation.
Wooded or dense tall vegetation.

classes.definition: Open grass-like vegetation, including pasture and lawns, with little taller vegetation.
phrases: Open grass-like vegetation.
Low grass cover with few tall plants.
An open area of grasses.

classes.definition: Vegetation visibly mixed with water in this image.
phrases: Vegetation mixed with visible water.
Water is visibly interspersed among plants.
Plants and visible water occur together.

classes.definition: Crops or grass planted in structured fields, including hay and fallow plots.
phrases: Planted or fallow agricultural fields.
Structured fields used for crops or hay.
Agricultural plots, including fallow fields.

classes.definition: Scattered low plants or shrubs with exposed soil or rock between them.
phrases: Scattered shrubs with exposed ground.
Low shrubs are dispersed across bare soil or rock.
Sparse low vegetation with visible ground between plants.

classes.definition: Buildings, roads or other large human-made surfaces, with associated small vegetation patches.
phrases: Buildings, roads and other constructed surfaces.
An area occupied by built structures and paving.
Human-made structures or paved surfaces.

classes.definition: Exposed soil, rock or sand with very little vegetation.
phrases: Bare soil, rock or sand.
Exposed ground with sparse or absent vegetation.
An area of largely unvegetated soil or rock.

source_text.limits: Finite source ontology and one-reviewer development contrasts; no image outcome or population semantic-similarity claim.
